# Impeccable

Stringless follows the structure of [Impeccable](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable) by Paul Bakaus: one skill with commands and shared context files such as PRODUCT.md. `reference/slop.md` also restates a few of the visual anti-patterns Impeccable warns about. No Impeccable files are included apart from the two below.

Impeccable is licensed under the Apache License 2.0. `LICENSE` and `NOTICE.md` are unmodified copies from commit `9e460a87ef338ee9d12c7beed8fedc597a5af5f7` of its repository.
